# Correlation

```{r}
cor.test(dataPs$count_disj, dataPs$count_conj, method = "pearson")
```

```{r}
ct <- cor.test(dataPs$count_conj, dataPs$count_disj)         
ct$estimate^2   # shared variance (r squared)
ct$conf.int^2   # rough range for r squared 
cor.test(dataPs$count_conj, dataPs$count_disj, method = "spearman")
```

## Percentile cut-offs

```{r}
# Calculate percentile thresholds (Conjunctions)
cutoffs <- quantile(
  dataPs$count_conj,
  probs = c(0.30, 0.70),
  na.rm = TRUE,
  names = FALSE,
  type = 7
)

lower_cutoff <- cutoffs[1]
upper_cutoff <- cutoffs[2]

print(c(
  lower_cutoff = lower_cutoff,
  upper_cutoff = upper_cutoff
))

print(table(dataPs$count_conj, useNA = "ifany"))

dataPs$Group_conj <- dplyr::case_when(
  dataPs$count_conj <= lower_cutoff ~ "Low agreement",
  dataPs$count_conj >= upper_cutoff ~ "High agreement",
  TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
)

table(dataPs$Group_conj, useNA = "ifany")
```


```{r}
# Calculate percentile thresholds (Disjunctions)
cutoffs <- quantile(
  dataPs$count_disj,
  probs = c(0.30, 0.70),
  na.rm = TRUE,
  names = FALSE,
  type = 7
)

lower_cutoff <- cutoffs[1]
upper_cutoff <- cutoffs[2]

print(c(
  lower_cutoff = lower_cutoff,
  upper_cutoff = upper_cutoff
))

print(table(dataPs$count_disj, useNA = "ifany"))

dataPs$Group_disj <- dplyr::case_when(
  dataPs$count_disj <= lower_cutoff ~ "Low agreement",
  dataPs$count_disj >= upper_cutoff ~ "High agreement",
  TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
)

table(dataPs$Group_disj, useNA = "ifany")
```

# Plot 1

```{r}

n_rel <- c(Conjunction = 6, Disjunction = 10)       
group_levels <- c("LA-Q", "Intermediate", "HA-B")
group_cols   <- c("LA-Q" = "#4C78A8", "Intermediate" = "grey75",
                  "HA-B" = "#D55E00")

to_k <- function(x, n) if (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 1) round(x * n) else round(x)

scores <- dataPs %>%
  transmute(Conjunction = to_k(count_conj, n_rel[["Conjunction"]]),
            Disjunction = to_k(count_disj, n_rel[["Disjunction"]]))

plot_data <- scores %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "measure", values_to = "k") %>%
  filter(!is.na(k)) %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = names(n_rel)))

cutoffs <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  summarise(lower = quantile(k, 0.30, names = FALSE, type = 7),
            upper = quantile(k, 0.70, names = FALSE, type = 7),
            .groups = "drop")

assign_group <- function(k, lower, upper) {
  factor(case_when(k <= lower ~ "LA-Q",
                   k >= upper ~ "HA-B",
                   TRUE       ~ "Intermediate"), levels = group_levels)
}

grid <- bind_rows(lapply(names(n_rel), function(m) tibble(measure = m, k = 0:n_rel[[m]]))) %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = names(n_rel)))

score_counts <- grid %>%
  left_join(cutoffs, by = "measure") %>%
  left_join(plot_data %>% count(measure, k, name = "n"), by = c("measure", "k")) %>%
  mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L),
         group = assign_group(k, lower, upper)) %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n),
         bar_label = if_else(n > 0, as.character(n), "")) %>%
  ungroup()

cut_txt <- cutoffs %>%
  mutate(txt = sprintf("%s: LA-Q \u2264 %g, HA-B \u2265 %g", measure, lower, upper)) %>%
  pull(txt) %>% paste(collapse = "; ")

group_sizes <- score_counts %>%
  distinct(measure, k, group, n) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n_participants = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

group_labels <- c(
  "Fallacy-prone",
  "Intermediate",
  "Normative"
)

group_cols <- c(
  "LA-Q" = "#4C78A8",
  "Intermediate"  = "#D9D9D9",
  "HA-B"     = "#D55E00"
)

score_counts <- score_counts %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_levels),
    bar_label = if_else(n > 0, as.character(n), "")
  )

classification_plot <- ggplot(
  score_counts,
  aes(x = k, y = percent, fill = group)
) +

geom_col(
  width = 0.88,
  colour = "white",
  linewidth = 0.3
) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = bar_label),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_cols,
    breaks = group_levels,
    labels = c(
      "LA-Q",
      "Intermediate",
      "HA-B"
    ),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = function(x) {
      seq(ceiling(min(x)), floor(max(x)), by = 1)
    },
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.16))
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    . ~ measure,
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x",
    labeller = as_labeller(
      c(
        Conjunction = "(a) Conjunction score",
        Disjunction = "(b) Disjunction score"
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Alignment with true constraints (number of matches)",
    y = "Participants (%)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 11.5,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),


    axis.line.x = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      colour = "#E6E6E6",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11.5,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(b = 7)
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),

    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.2, "cm"),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 9)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 9)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 8, r = 10, b = 8, l = 8
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(classification_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "fig_conj_disj_classification.tiff",
  plot = classification_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)
```

# Plot 2

```{r}
complete_scores <- scores %>%
  rename(k_conj = Conjunction, k_disj = Disjunction) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

pear <- cor.test(complete_scores$k_conj, complete_scores$k_disj, method = "pearson")
spear <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(complete_scores$k_conj, complete_scores$k_disj,
                                   method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
p_txt <- function(p) if (p < .001) "< .001" else sprintf("= %.3f", p)
correlation_text <- sprintf("r = %.2f, p %s  (Spearman \u03C1 = %.2f); n = %d",
                            unname(pear$estimate), p_txt(pear$p.value),
                            unname(spear$estimate), nrow(complete_scores))

lc <- cutoffs$lower[cutoffs$measure == "Conjunction"]; uc <- cutoffs$upper[cutoffs$measure == "Conjunction"]
ld <- cutoffs$lower[cutoffs$measure == "Disjunction"]; ud <- cutoffs$upper[cutoffs$measure == "Disjunction"]

joint_levels <- c("LA-Q on both", "Other combinations", "HA-B on both")
joint_cols   <- c("LA-Q on both" = "#4C78A8", "Other combinations" = "grey70",
                  "HA-B on both" = "#D55E00")

cells <- complete_scores %>%
  mutate(g_conj = assign_group(k_conj, lc, uc),
         g_disj = assign_group(k_disj, ld, ud),
         joint = factor(case_when(g_conj == "LA-Q" & g_disj == "LA-Q" ~ "LA-Q on both",
                                  g_conj == "HA-B"     & g_disj == "HA-B"     ~ "HA-B on both",
                                  TRUE ~ "Other combinations"), levels = joint_levels)) %>%
  count(k_conj, k_disj, joint, name = "n")

correlation_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_smooth(data = complete_scores, aes(k_conj, k_disj), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
              se = TRUE, colour = "black", fill = "grey55", alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = cells, aes(k_conj, k_disj, size = n, fill = joint),
             shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8, alpha = 0.92) +
  geom_text(data = filter(cells, n >= 4), aes(k_conj, k_disj, label = n, colour = joint),
            size = 3, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 13, breaks = c(1, 4, 8), name = "Participants") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = joint_cols, breaks = joint_levels, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("LA-Q on both" = "white",
                                 "Other combinations" = "grey15",
                                 "HA-B on both" = "white")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.4, 6.4), ylim = c(-0.6, 10.6)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5)),
         size = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(fill = "grey70", colour = "white"))) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.02, vjust = -0.8,
           label = correlation_text, size = 3.3) +
  labs(
       x = "Conjunction score (relations in alignment, out of 6)",
       y = "Disjunction score (relations in alignment, out of 10)") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(correlation_plot)

ggsave("fig_conj_disj_correlation.tiff", correlation_plot,
       width = 6.2, height = 5.2, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

# ANOVA
## Reshaping the data

```{r}
dataPs <- rename(
  dataPs,
  G_H  = GH,
  G_L  = GL,
  NG_H = NGH,
  NG_L = NGL
)
names(dataPs)
```

```{r}
df_long <- pivot_longer(dataPs, cols = c(G_H, G_L, NG_H, NG_L),names_to = "Grammaticality_ChunkStrength", values_to = "Endorsement")
```

```{r}
df_long <- separate(df_long, Grammaticality_ChunkStrength, into = c("Grammaticality", "ChunkStrength"), sep = "_")
```

```{r}
Grammaticality_levels <- c("G" = "Grammatical", "NG" = "Nongrammatical")
chunk_strength_levels <- c("H" = "High", "L" = "Low")
df_long$Grammaticality <- factor(df_long$Grammaticality, levels = names(Grammaticality_levels), labels = Grammaticality_levels)
df_long$ChunkStrength <- factor(df_long$ChunkStrength, levels = names(chunk_strength_levels), labels = chunk_strength_levels)
```

```{r}
str(df_long$Grammaticality)
str(df_long$ChunkStrength)
```

### Repeated-measures 2x2 ANOVA

```{r}
result_within <- aov_car(Endorsement ~ Grammaticality * ChunkStrength + Error(id/(Grammaticality * ChunkStrength)), data = df_long)
summary(result_within)
```

## Pairwise t-tests 

```{r}
pairwise.t.test(df_long$Endorsement, interaction(df_long$ChunkStrength, df_long$Grammaticality), p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```

# Compute means and standard deviations

```{r}
summary_data <- df_long %>%

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_data)

```

# RSS
## Min–max normalise: chunkStrength

```{r}
# Passive data
dataPassive$chunkStrength_norm <- (
  dataPassive$chunkStrength - min(dataPassive$chunkStrength)
) / (max(dataPassive$chunkStrength) - min(dataPassive$chunkStrength))

```

## Define an RSS function

```{r}
rss <- function(observed, predicted) {
  sum((observed - predicted)^2)
}
```

### Compute RSS for passive learning 

```{r}
RSS_Bayesian <- rss(dataPassive$Observed, dataPassive$Bayesian_predicted)
RSS_Quantum <- rss(dataPassive$Observed, dataPassive$Quantum_predicted)
RSS_chunkStrength <- rss(dataPassive$Observed, dataPassive$chunkStrength_norm)
RSS_grammaticality <- rss(dataPassive$Observed, dataPassive$grammaticality)
```


```{r}
RSS_results_Passive <- data.frame(
  Predictor = c("Bayesian", "Quantum", "Chunk Strength (norm)", "Grammaticality"),
  RSS = c(RSS_Bayesian, RSS_Quantum, RSS_chunkStrength, RSS_grammaticality)
)

RSS_results_Passive
```

# Plot 4

### Create the category variable

```{r}
# Passive
dataPassive$category <- cut(
  seq_len(nrow(dataPassive)),
  breaks = c(0, 8, 16, 24, 32),
  labels = c("GH", "GL", "NGH", "NGL")
)

```

# Individual participant performance
## 1) Passive Group
## Convert Yes/No to 1/0

```{r}
item_cols <- setdiff(names(dataIndPassive), "id")

dataIndPassive[item_cols] <- lapply(dataIndPassive[item_cols], function(x) {
  ifelse(x == "Yes", 1,
         ifelse(x == "No", 0, NA))
})
```

```{r}
table(unlist(dataIndPassive[item_cols]), useNA = "ifany")
```

## Calculate the group-level endorsement for each item

```{r}
group_endorsement <- colMeans(dataIndPassive[item_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
group_endorsement
```

## Leave-one-out individual-to-average correlation

```{r}
# Calculate leave-one-participant-out correlations
individual_correlations_loo <- numeric(nrow(dataIndPassive))

for (i in 1:nrow(dataIndPassive)) {
  
  # Participant's own responses
  participant_responses <- as.numeric(dataIndPassive[i, item_cols])
  
  # Group endorsement profile excluding participant i
  group_without_i <- colMeans(
    dataIndPassive[-i, item_cols],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  # Only use items with valid responses
  complete <- !is.na(participant_responses) &
              !is.na(group_without_i)
  
  # Correlation between participant and the remaining group
  individual_correlations_loo[i] <- cor(
    participant_responses[complete],
    group_without_i[complete],
    method = "pearson"
  )
}

# Add correlations to the dataset
dataIndPassive$individual_group_r_loo <- individual_correlations_loo
```

```{r}
summary(dataIndPassive$individual_group_r_loo)
```

# split-half analysis
## Randomly split participants into two groups

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

n_splits <- 1000

split_correlations <- numeric(n_splits)

for (s in 1:n_splits) {
  
  # Randomly assign participants to two groups
  group_assignment <- sample(
    c(rep(1, floor(nrow(dataIndPassive) / 2)),
      rep(2, ceiling(nrow(dataIndPassive) / 2)))
  )
  
  group1 <- dataIndPassive[group_assignment == 1, item_cols]
  group2 <- dataIndPassive[group_assignment == 2, item_cols]
  
  # Average endorsement for each item in each group
  endorsement1 <- colMeans(group1, na.rm = TRUE)
  endorsement2 <- colMeans(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Correlation between the two 32-item profiles
  complete <- !is.na(endorsement1) & !is.na(endorsement2)
  
  split_correlations[s] <- cor(
    endorsement1[complete],
    endorsement2[complete],
    method = "pearson"
  )
}
```


```{r}
summary(split_correlations)
```

# Monte Carlo null simulation (a parametric bootstrap under the null, though "Monte Carlo test")

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

n_participants <- nrow(dataIndPassive)
n_sims <- 1000  # number of synthetic null datasets to generate

# "True" item-level probabilities, estimated from our actual
# full-group average (this is the null hypothesis: every
# participant shares these same probabilities, no individual
# differences)
true_p <- colMeans(dataIndPassive[, item_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
n_items <- length(true_p)

# Storage for the null distributions
null_loo_means <- numeric(n_sims)
null_split_means <- numeric(n_sims)

for (sim in 1:n_sims) {

  # Generate synthetic data: each cell is one Bernoulli
  # draw from the corresponding item's true probability. No
  # participant-level heterogeneity is built in by construction. 
  synth <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_participants, ncol = n_items)
  for (j in 1:n_items) {
    synth[, j] <- rbinom(n_participants, size = 1, prob = true_p[j])
  }
  colnames(synth) <- item_cols

  # Leave-one-out correlation 
  loo_r <- numeric(n_participants)
  for (i in 1:n_participants) {
    participant_responses <- synth[i, ]
    group_without_i <- colMeans(synth[-i, ], na.rm = TRUE)
    complete <- !is.na(participant_responses) & !is.na(group_without_i)
    loo_r[i] <- suppressWarnings(cor(
      participant_responses[complete],
      group_without_i[complete],
      method = "pearson"
    ))
  }
  null_loo_means[sim] <- mean(loo_r, na.rm = TRUE)

# Split-half correlation
  group_assignment <- sample(
    c(rep(1, floor(n_participants / 2)),
      rep(2, ceiling(n_participants / 2)))
  )
  group1 <- synth[group_assignment == 1, ]
  group2 <- synth[group_assignment == 2, ]
  endorsement1 <- colMeans(group1, na.rm = TRUE)
  endorsement2 <- colMeans(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
  complete <- !is.na(endorsement1) & !is.na(endorsement2)
  null_split_means[sim] <- suppressWarnings(cor(
    endorsement1[complete],
    endorsement2[complete],
    method = "pearson"
  ))
}

# Compare our observed statistics against these null distributions
cat("Null distribution of mean LOO correlation (no real heterogeneity):\n")
print(summary(null_loo_means))

cat("\nOur observed mean LOO correlation: ", mean(dataIndPassive$individual_group_r_loo, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Percentile of observed value within null distribution: ",
    mean(null_loo_means <= mean(dataIndPassive$individual_group_r_loo, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100, "%\n\n")

cat("Null distribution of split-half correlation (no real heterogeneity):\n")
print(summary(null_split_means))

cat("\nOur observed mean split-half correlation: ", mean(split_correlations), "\n")
cat("Percentile of observed value within null distribution: ",
    mean(null_split_means <= mean(split_correlations)) * 100, "%\n")
```
